reviews.review:
[h1]Here's what you do:[/h1]
You go through levels shooting at enemies while popping in and out from behind cover. Some places you can move back and forth between cover spots where it becomes necessary to avoid grenades or something. You are given money after each level which is used to purchase new guns and more ammo for your guns. Levels do not have checkpoints because they are all short.

[h1]What I like:[/h1]
+ You can customize the outfits of the three main characters (one playable) in the story, but there aren't a whole lot of options. 
+ The game is open about users adding mod material, but there hasn't been a lot made in the steam community, sadly.

[h1]What I don't like:[/h1]
- The game is short: eight levels which take three to five minutes each to play.
- A handful of grammar mistakes in the dialog text.
- The story ends on a cliffhanger, but there is a sequel game out now.

[h1]Conclusion:[/h1]
I recommend this game because I found it fun, but I must say it feels short, has grammar mistakes, and not a lot of replay value (which it would have if it came with more customize options). It didn't crash or bug out on me, but it lacks a lot of polish. Maybe wait for a sale. I will be on the look out for better on-rail cover shooters, but there are few pickings on Steam right now.

[h1]Want a more detailed look? Watch this:[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2099105343
